name: Shockolate
description:
Shockolate is a cross-platform, open-source source port of the revolutionary 1994 cyberpunk immersive sim System Shock. Based on the original source code, it brings Citadel Station natively to modern Linux PCs.

Features:
- Native 64-bit Linux execution with OpenGL hardware-accelerated rendering
- Modern mouselook controls and customizable WASD movement
- True widescreen support and high-resolution texture rendering
- Corrected audio timing and support for digital sound effects and MIDI tracks
- Complete compatibility with original System Shock CD-ROM game assets
